title: Northbeam Circle Membership Reward Point Earning Rates and Yearly Ceiling
content:
| Figure | Circle Free Membership | Circle Plus Annual | Circle Total Annual | Circle Total Household Annual | Circle Business Pro | Circle Business Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base points per USD of qualifying merchandise spend | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 2 | 2.5 |
| Extra points per USD on computing, mobile and home-theatre merchandise | 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 |
| Extra points per USD on major appliances | 0 | 0.25 | 0.75 | 1 | 1 | 1.5 |
| Extra points on a protection plan, as a percentage of the plan price | 0 | 2 | 5 | 5 | 6 | 8 |
| Most points earnable in one calendar year | 20000 | 60000 | 150000 | 150000 | 400000 | 1000000 |

## What each rate on this card is

The figures above are the reward point earning rates carried by each tier of Northbeam Circle
Membership. The base rate is the points earned per USD of qualifying merchandise spend. The computing,
mobile and home-theatre figure and the major appliance figure are extra points per USD on merchandise in
those departments. The protection plan figure is stated as a percentage of the plan price and is earned
in points when a plan is bought. The yearly cap is the most points a membership may earn in one calendar
year.

## What each figure comes to per USD spent

Every figure on this card is a number of points per USD, so each converts directly. A base rate of 0.5
points per USD carries 50 points for each hypothetical 100.00 of spend, a base rate of 1.5 points per
USD carries 150 points for the same 100.00, and a base rate of 2.5 points per USD carries 250 points.
The computing, mobile and home-theatre figure of 2 points per USD on Circle Business Elite carries 200
points for each 100.00 of spend in that department, and the major appliance figure of 0.25 points per USD
on Circle Plus Annual carries 25 points. On Circle Free Membership both department figures stand at 0,
so no figure is carried there on any department.

The protection plan figure is a percentage of the plan price rather than a rate per USD: 2 percent on
Circle Plus Annual, 5 percent on both Circle Total tiers, 6 percent on Circle Business Pro and 8 percent
on Circle Business Elite, against 0 on Circle Free Membership.

The yearly ceiling separates the tiers by a wide margin: 20000 points on Circle Free Membership, 60000
on Circle Plus Annual, 150000 on Circle Total Annual and on Circle Total Household Annual, 400000 on
Circle Business Pro and 1000000 on Circle Business Elite.
